name: io.github.arthi-arumugam-git/caelo
description: Free, local security scanner for AI-built apps. Finds exposed keys and open databases: Stripe/OpenAI/AWS/GitHub keys, browser-leaked secrets (NEXT_PUBLIC/VITE), Supabase service-role keys and RLS gaps, open Firebase rules, committed .env. Reads files only, uploads nothing, redacts every secret it prints.

packageArguments.name: --mcp
packageArguments.description: Run Caelo as an MCP server over stdio
